title: Incursa VS Code and Local Tooling Portfolio
purpose: Define the machine-verifiable product, portability, security, packaging, and release contract for the Incursa tooling portfolio.

requirements.title: Keep product boundaries independent
requirements.statement: The portfolio MUST keep domain extensions and standalone tools independently buildable, versioned, packaged, installed, upgraded, and uninstalled while the Incursa Tooling extension remains metadata-only.

requirements.title: Preserve portable web cores
requirements.statement: SpecTrace and CSV Contract Workbench MUST retain tested VS Code web-host workflows and browser bundles MUST exclude desktop-only dependencies.

requirements.title: Compare CSVs deterministically
requirements.statement: CSV semantic comparison MUST provide deterministic full-row and keyed results, explicit normalization, exact duplicate handling, bounded diagnostics, and evidence outputs.

requirements.title: Keep desktop helpers optional and safe
requirements.statement: Desktop helpers MUST remain optional, require Workspace Trust, use allowlisted structured commands, preserve cancellation and timeouts, and bound output.

requirements.title: Browse verified database knowledge
requirements.statement: Database Knowledge Workbench MUST verify, index, search, and inspect sanitized knowledge bundles without live SQL or mutation of verified bundles.

requirements.title: Preserve canonical auditable reports
requirements.statement: Auditable Reports MUST preserve Report Markdown and artifact.json, resolve the installed compiler on Windows, produce canonical paginated output, forward print settings, and publish atomically.

requirements.title: Package safe standalone tools
requirements.statement: Repo Manager, Crystal Report Inspector, and PDF Workbench MUST provide safe portable packages with capability inspection and accurate prerequisite boundaries.

requirements.title: Verify extension releases
requirements.statement: Every extension MUST verify branding, accessibility, tests, VSIX identity and contents, confidentiality, byte count, and SHA-256 before release.

requirements.title: Install pinned components per user
requirements.statement: Incursa Tooling Setup MUST be user-scoped, selectable, offline-capable, repairable, upgradeable, and consume only immutable verified component artifacts without deleting user-authored data.

requirements.title: Protect confidentiality and privacy
requirements.statement: Public source and packages MUST contain no customer material or credentials and portfolio products MUST default to no telemetry, no upload, no background listener, and fail-closed mutation boundaries.
